lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: MOM, WHY IS THERE TWO MILLION DOLLARS SITTING IN A SWISS ACCOUNT UNDER MY NAME?

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Lower your voice right now [beat] before your father hears you and starts asking questions that neither of us can answer!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Too late for that [beat] because I just saw the bank notification on the family tablet and I want an explanation immediately.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It’s not just money [beat] there’s a direct link to Principal Huda’s private firm hidden in every single transaction history.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: You don't understand the pressure I was under [beat] Huda promised to erase your record if I let her use your identity.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: That’s not a business deal [beat] that’s money laundering 101 and you just made your own son the primary suspect in a crime.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You mean the police will think I’m the one who stole the school’s renovation budget [beat] while I was sitting in detention?

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: We were going to move it back [beat] but the password was changed by someone else the moment the funds landed in the account.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: You let a corrupt principal use our son as a human shield for her crimes [beat] and now the money is just gone?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: It isn't gone [beat] it’s currently being processed as a voluntary donation from Nix to my new offshore development project.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Principal Huda? How did you even get into our house [beat] and why are you holding my laptop like it’s a weapon?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Because the files on this drive are worth more than your entire family's future [beat] and I am not leaving without the key.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You’ll have to take it from me [beat] because I just sent the login details to the police about ten seconds ago.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: You little brat [beat] you have no idea what you’ve just started or who is really coming for that money now.
